The [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW article">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maps-charting-the-galaxy|text=''Star Wars'' Maps: Charting the Galaxy|nolive=1}}</ref> '''Couronne'''<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> was the namesake of the [[Couronne system/Legends|Couronne system]] in the [[Couronne sector/Legends|Couronne sector]],<ref name="Atlas" /> located within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|99|Imzig}}</ref> [[Imzig]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

[[Utris M'Toc]], once a member of the [[High King's Guard]] on Couronne, was forced to leave the Imzig home planet following a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] coup.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
Couronne featured as the Imzig homeworld in the [[Star Wars Insider 48|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]] article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards]],"<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> published in [[March]] [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref>

In developing Couronne's background for "Rogues Gallery," contributor [[Kevin Beentjes]] consulted with [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/naming-the-cloud-city-wing-guards/714850175231759|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Mar 6, 2014|quote='''Utris M'toc''': Now has a homeplanet, as does his species, the Imzig. Kevin, who created M'toc's background, asked additional information about Couronne at Jason Fry, since it was a planet with no background at all from The Atlas.}}</ref> co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and its corresponding [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]], the latter of which originally established a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] named Couronne located in grid square P-10.<ref name="Atlas" />
